description: Internal: a secret changed in the secrets worker — re-resolve the secret:// credential reference and refresh the providers that use it.

request_schema.description: Advisory `secrets::changed` event delivered to `router::on_secret_changed`. It never carries a value; the handler re-reads the reference through `secrets::resolve`. Other payload fields (`fingerprint`, `updated_at`) are ignored.

ref.description: The same secret as a `secret://NAME` reference (advisory).

request_schema.title: SecretChangedEvent

response_schema.description: Generic acknowledgement returned by trigger-bound handlers whose result is not consumed by callers (kept typed so the response schema is concrete).
response_schema.title: RouterAck
